target_customer: Retailers, venues and enterprises that want indoor location and proximity sensing, plus app developers
problem: Smartphones could not tell what room or object they were near; Bluetooth beacons and later UWB sensors add indoor context for apps.
business_model: Hardware sales plus software platform and SDK
product_category: Indoor location hardware and software (beacons, UWB, SpaceTimeOS)

founders.name: Jakub Krzych
education: Jagiellonian University, Physics and Computer Science

competitors.name: Qualcomm Gimbal
competitors.what: Bluetooth LE proximity beacons positioned as an alternative to iBeacon hardware
competitors.traction_then: Series 10 and Series 20 beacons launched at $5 and $10 each

technical_complexity.rationale: Required custom low-power Bluetooth LE hardware, firmware, mobile SDKs and cloud together at a time when iBeacon had just been introduced by Apple.

defensibility.rationale: Beacons were commoditized quickly, with Qualcomm and others selling at $5 to $10 each; Estimote's stated goal was to build a trusted brand and platform around them.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Qualcomm launched Gimbal in December 2013 and Apple defined iBeacon; Estimote later shifted focus to UWB and SpaceTimeOS, and a retailer blog says it stopped responding to beacon purchase enquiries (undated, unconfirmed).

market_need_then: Apple introduced iBeacon in 2013 and a Business Insider article described beacons as a new tech battleground, with retailers wanting in-store proximity marketing.

branding.name_origin: Combination of estimate and mote, where a mote is a tiny speck; the CEO said the project was first called cuckoo because the device looked like a bird with an eye.
branding.brand_signature: Estimote Sticker, a beacon model whose name spread to the wider industry
branding.community_and_virality: Developer community and forums around the beacons; the sticker term became industry vocabulary.

brand_strength.rationale: A TechCrunch piece quotes the company aiming to be the brand for beacons as Apple was for iBeacons, and Business Insider named it among the largest beacon firms, but it did not become a lasting platform brand.

pivots.to: UWB sensors and SpaceTimeOS location platform
pivots.why: Not stated by a source; the current site focuses on UWB anchors and SpaceTimeOS.

outcome_analysis: Estimote rode Apple's 2013 iBeacon launch, raising a 3.1 million dollar seed in December 2013 and a 10.7 million dollar Series A in January 2016. Beacon hardware commoditized as Qualcomm and others sold at a few dollars each, and no later round is public. It remains active with 40 staff and has repositioned around UWB and SpaceTimeOS.
notes: Series A conflicts: 6.5M (BounceWatch) and 7M (StartupIntros) are treated as outliers versus 10.7M reported by TechCrunch, FinSMEs and others. CB Insights totals 13.82M over four rounds, so one small earlier round is not identified. The CB Insights longer investor list is uncorroborated. Founding year 2012 from the YC page. Confidence is rated high for founders and competition partially; competitor source is dated December 2013, a few months after the batch.
